positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built a web app from scratch that automates model serving pipeline for an NLP-based document classification model for auditing thousands of documents using Hack PHP, React.js, Hive, MySQL and Mercurial.
Initiated and leaded meetings with cross functional teams to align on the scope and expectation for every feature.
Successfully designed and pitched ideas of frontend, backend and schemas for database to different pillars.
Contributed to Robotics team’s virtual conferencing Pan-Tilt-Zoom feature at 2020 Global Summer Hackathon.

positions.title: Mathematics Department Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Managed weekly problem sessions to help students with their coursework to deepen their understanding and interest in Math.
MATH 102 Calculus II: Fall 2016 (Grader)
MATH 203 Linear Algebra: Spring 2017, Spring 2018 (with Professor Peter Kasius)
MATH 101 Calculus I: Fall 2017 (with Professor Amy Myers)
MATH 303 Real Analysis: Fall 2019 (with Professor Leslie Cheng)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
At Software Platform Lab, supervised by Professor Byung-gon Chun
• Participated in designing a main system for pipelining and serving video-analytics models online to gain higher throughput by replicating and batching multiple tasks on GPUs.
• Proactively researched and tested object detection models’ accuracy and latency when deep neural network architectures are split between layers and run on different environment such as Raspberry Pi, Jetson TX2 and NVIDIA GPUs.
• Presented the state-of-the-art papers regarding facial expression recognition, pose estimation, action recognition, object detection models to update team on research trends.

positions.title: President and Portfolio Analyst (BMC Student-Run Finance Club)
positions.description:
• Organized the Annual Internship Panel by inviting upper-classmen who worked in finance sectors during summer to share their experiences and made posters to advertise the event
• Gave presentations on market updates at the general meeting and pitched stocks at the portfolio committee meeting every week and analyzed club’s portfolio worth of $140K.
•Managed mailing list of 370 students and sent out important announcement, meeting schedules, internship/job opportunities to the club mail subscribers

positions.title: Product Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Initiated a new co-creating platform project that aims to connect people with similar interests through offline events. Successfully presented the prototype using Mockingbot and business plan using Keynote.
• Created document on developing current dashboard to Property Management System that can allow operations team, short-term rental hosts and company’s co-hosts to manage incoming guests, properties and money flow more efficiently.
• Created new products for short-term rental hosts and attracted more than 1000+ users. Created referral system for all types of users as viral marketing strategy.
• Developed company’s identity as social venture sponsoring young local artists’ housings and platform to show their work and creativity to public through company’s profits.

positions.title: Business Technology Department Intern
positions.description:
• Optimized and updated the list of QlikView business intelligence applications that were created and retired in 2016 and created visualizations to monitor and track user adoption
• Interviewed users and owners of Finance QlikView applications to analyze training needs and design tutorial video scripts. Improved system for communicating requirements to the video creator.
• Reviewed an extensive, undifferentiated list of reports from the PIWIK web analytics tool to identify useful data that answered specific questions regarding user adoption, frequency of use.
• Prepared and delivered formal presentation on various findings and task outcomes to a team of IT professionals. Presented findings in a way that generated active discussion among the team.

honors.title: PennAppsXX Hackathon Top 10
honors.description:
Won Best Hardware Hack, Best Healthcare Hack, Top 10 among 250 teams
Created a walker that assists blind elders in walking with team of four. Implemented obstacle prevention algorithm by calculating depth from Intel Realsense D435 using Python and OpenCV. Integrated customized Alexa Skills as UI for better accessibility.

honors.title: 2019 CRA-W Grace Hopper Conference (GHC) Research Scholar
honors.description: Received full scholarship to attend 2019 Grace Hopper Conference as a research scholar.

• Helped ~40 low-income families in Norristown, PA file their tax return
• Certified as a Volunteer Income Tax Assistant (VITA) by passing the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) exams

projects.title: End-to-End Video Super Resolution on GPU
projects.description: - Streamlined and accelerated Super Resolution model RBPN (Haris et al. CVPR '19) end-to-end using NVVL (NVIDIA) for extracting frames from videos and FlowNet2 (Ilg et al. CVPR '17/ NVVL PyTorch Implementation) for extracting optical flows using GPUs.

projects.title: Real-Time Human Action Recognition
projects.description:
- Built an end-to-end system that recognizes human actions in real- time in distributed environment with streamed input from Raspberry Pi and computations done in different environment such as Jetson TX2 and NVIDIA GPUs.
- Presented poster on 'Investigating Inefficiencies and Proposing Improvements towards Real-Time Action Recognition with Two- Stream Networks' in Korea Computer Congress 2019.
